fields.summary_ko.0: AVGO is trading at $353, approximately 27% below its June record of $481.57, but could reach approximately $600 by 2030, representing an annual appreciation rate of approximately 14%.
fields.summary_ko.1: AVGO's AI semiconductor revenue reached $16.7B in Q3 2026 with 221% year-over-year growth, expected to reach approximately $115B in 2027 and $230B in 2028.
fields.summary_ko.2: CEO Hock Tan expects 2028 EPS to exceed $30, with the estimated 2030 year-end stock price of $600 coming solely from net income growth, assuming the P/E ratio will decline from 18x to 15x.
